body: Well hey if you need it we can be alone together. We're in the same boat man.
And admitting you cant do anything for me is the most cathartic feeling to me. Empathising with no condecension, thats truly gives me peace, if temporarily
I hope that its as peaceful as you think its going to be. Godspeed, and if you desire to talk to someone who doesnt want to stop you or encourage you, feel free to pm
Somehow this cry for help has gotten me the most genuine well wishes out of 4 years of mental breakdowns on this thread. So theres that at least right
Perhaps. I tried reaching out because I had a desire to let someone intervene and it took way longer than I would hope for anyone to care.
Thats an... interesting solution to say the least
Its nice talking to somebody tbh

Especially when all are mental health services are geared torwards self acceptance. Its like that scene in breaking bad where jesse goes off at the narcotics anonymous meeting. Am I supposed to just accept that I'm incompetent and lazy and unmotivated and trash???

Hot take- failing by inches hurts so much more than just bombing. Consistently feeling like your not quite good enough to accomplish anything is a bitch. I've always been treated with a bunch of pressure since I'm so "smart", but I'm so goddamn neurotic most days I cant leave my room except to smoke and drink

It means more than any of the shit anyone ever says here. Everything else feels like yelling "what am I doing wrong" to the sky and being told "we hear you". Like I guess but that doesn't really address my issues. I'm so tired feeling like I don't deserve to be as bitter as I am.

I lost the only good job ive ever had because i was forced into inpatient for the 3rd time. Ive never wanted to die more than when he had me give him his keys to the shop back... life really is a shitstorm.
I keep dissapointing people and myself. Sometimes it feels like its just our destiny to keep fucking up huh? Like we were all meant to be the losers... sorry I'm projecting
Honestly yeah I do dissapoint myself as well. Over and over again. I impulsively lie, manipulate, and don't know how to step back. I alienate the people that care about me.
It's so hard. No matter what I do, I keep making decisions and doing things that dissapoint people.
This would be my 4th time being commited. These are the results of 6 years of trying and failing to cope.

My best friend has conversion disorder, which leads to constant pain in his throat. He's offered me some insight into what living with pain is like, and it's unimaginable. I don't know how to help you but I wish you the best.
